newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR mostly steady on rate uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR mostly steady on rate uncertainty.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were generally steady on Friday as banks decided to keep them unchanged ahead of Monday's T-bill auction, traders said.
"Everybody is still waiting on what will happen to the long-term rates on Monday," one trader said.
The market is divided on the direction of local rates as the Central Bank has been siphoning off liquidity by selling dollars in the past days.
Six billion pesos worth of floating rate notes due to mature on Tuesday are expected to counter the Central Bank's mopping up operation.
The two-week and one-month rates went down, but only on a marginal tick. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
